toursPage.title: Private tours of Montenegro
toursPage.subtitle: Choose one of our carefully crafted tours with a private driver and discover the most beautiful parts of the country at your own pace.

kotor-perast-tivat.title: Kotor · Perast · Tivat
kotor-perast-tivat.shortDescription: Medieval Kotor, the gem of Perast and luxury Porto Montenegro marina — the beauty of Boka Bay in one day.
kotor-perast-tivat.description: If you want to experience the true beauty of Boka Bay, this is the perfect tour for you. From the medieval streets of Kotor and the timeless charm of Perast to the luxury waterfront of Porto Montenegro, this journey combines history, culture, and breathtaking coastal scenery in one unforgettable day.
highlights: Perast — Our Lady of the Rocks

stops.name: Kotor
stops.desc: One of the most beautiful towns on the Adriatic coast, famous for its Old Town, charming stone streets, and impressive medieval fortifications.

stops.name: Perast
stops.desc: A small coastal gem known for its baroque architecture and breathtaking views of Our Lady of the Rocks, which can be reached by boat.

stops.name: Tivat
stops.desc: A modern seaside town and home to Porto Montenegro, a luxury marina known for its yachts, waterfront restaurants, and relaxing atmosphere.

biogradska-gora.title: Biograd Lake · Biogradska Gora
biogradska-gora.shortDescription: One of Europe's last primeval forests, a crystal-clear lake and untouched mountain nature of Montenegro.
biogradska-gora.description: Discover one of Montenegro's most breathtaking natural gems! Nestled in the heart of Biogradska Gora National Park, Biograd Lake is surrounded by one of Europe's last remaining primeval forests, offering spectacular mountain scenery and peaceful nature.
highlights: One of Europe's last primeval forests

stops.name: Biogradska Gora
stops.desc: A national park preserving one of Europe's last primeval forests, home to rare plant and animal species.

stops.name: Biograd Lake
stops.desc: A crystal-clear mountain lake perfect for walking, relaxation, photography and a seasonal boat ride.

durmitor-tara.title: Žabljak · Black Lake · Tara Bridge
durmitor-tara.shortDescription: The mountain peaks of Durmitor, crystal Black Lake and the bridge above the deepest canyon in Europe.
durmitor-tara.description: If you want to experience the nature Montenegro is famous for, this is the right tour. From the mighty mountain peaks of Durmitor to the spectacular Tara canyon, some of the most beautiful scenery in the country awaits you.
highlights: Žabljak — highest town in the Balkans

stops.name: Žabljak
stops.desc: The highest town in the Balkans and the heart of Durmitor National Park, surrounded by untouched nature and mountain landscapes.

stops.name: Black Lake
stops.desc: One of the most beautiful lakes in Montenegro, ideal for walking, relaxation and photos you will remember for a long time.

stops.name: Tara Bridge
stops.desc: One of the most famous symbols of Montenegro, with an unforgettable view of the Tara canyon — the deepest canyon in Europe.

lipa-rijeka-pavlova.title: Lipa Cave · Rijeka Crnojevića · Pavlova Strana
lipa-rijeka-pavlova.shortDescription: Underground chambers of Lipa, the peaceful Crnojevića river and the most beautiful viewpoint in Montenegro.
lipa-rijeka-pavlova.description: If you want to discover the natural beauty and authentic spirit of Montenegro, this tour is the right choice. From the fascinating underground world of Lipa Cave, through the peaceful Rijeka Crnojevića, to one of the most famous viewpoints in the country.
highlights: Lake Skadar from a bird's eye view

stops.name: Lipa Cave
stops.desc: Explore one of the largest caves in Montenegro and discover impressive underground chambers, stalactites and stalagmites on a guided tour.

stops.name: Rijeka Crnojevića
stops.desc: A charming place with a rich history, surrounded by untouched nature and a river leading to Lake Skadar. Perfect for a stroll or a boat ride.

stops.name: Pavlova Strana
stops.desc: One of the most famous viewpoints in Montenegro with a spectacular view of the Rijeka Crnojevića meander.

budva-sveti-stefan-virpazar.title: Budva · Sveti Stefan · Virpazar
budva-sveti-stefan-virpazar.shortDescription: Budva Old Town, iconic Sveti Stefan and a cruise on Lake Skadar — sea and nature in one day.
budva-sveti-stefan-virpazar.description: If you want to experience the best of the Montenegrin coast and Lake Skadar in one day, this is the right tour. A blend of history, stunning viewpoints, sea and untouched nature provides an experience you will remember for a long time.

stops.name: Budva
stops.desc: One of the oldest towns on the Adriatic, known for its Old Town, beautiful beaches and vibrant atmosphere.

stops.name: Sveti Stefan
stops.desc: One of the symbols of Montenegro and the most photographed spots on the Adriatic. The perfect place for unforgettable photos.

stops.name: Virpazar
stops.desc: A small fishing village, the ideal starting point for a boat ride through Lake Skadar National Park.

about.title: Your local travel partner
about.subtitle: Montenegro Transfer Group is a family company dedicated to making every journey comfortable, safe and unforgettable.
about.storyP1: Founded with a simple idea — that guests of Montenegro get transportation they can count on. No waiting, no uncertainty and no unpleasant price surprises.
about.storyP2: Our drivers are not just professionals behind the wheel, but real guides who are happy to share stories, tips and recommendations about our country. Whether we drive you from the airport to the hotel or on a full-day tour, we strive to make every kilometre enjoyable.

values.title: Local team
values.desc: Drivers born in Montenegro who know every road and hidden corner.

values.title: We cover the whole country
values.desc: From the coast to the mountainous north — we drive you everywhere.

values.title: Foreign languages
values.desc: We communicate in English, Russian and German.

values.title: No hidden costs
values.desc: You know the price before departure — transparent and fair.
